messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: long_context_factuality dropped 14% on v13b+ptq-int8 (2026-03-19 06:00 UTC). failing promptset: longctx_facts_v2. link: https://evals.local/failures/2045678901 :rotating_light:
maya: ugh, saw this in the dashboard this morning. numbers look real. any quick reproducer? :eyes:
eval-bot: repro script attached in run: `scripts/repro_longctx.sh` (samples + seed). example failure id: 2045678901-43. sample snippet attached in run artifacts.
chris: grabbing the sample. initial glance: the model hallucinates a non-existent date in the middle of a long doc summary. seems correlated with token-length > 2048 after tokenization.
anya: did we change tokenizer merges in v13b? I remember a small BPE vocabulary normalization landed last week.
nick: yep, commit d4f7b3 changed merge normalization for unicode whitespace. intended to fix weird split on emojis. should be safe but could shift offsets.
sam: also the ptq-int8 config we ran used asymmetric per-channel calibration (calib_v2). Could amplify quant noise on long KV cache reads.
maya: ok possibilities: 1) tokenizer shift causing different token boundaries -> prompts > seqlen margin -> KV miscues. 2) quantization kernel causing accumulating error over long context. 3) rollout combined both (we rolled v13b+ptq in canary).
chris: can we bisect? reproduce on non-quantized weights + new tokenizer, and old tokenizer + quantized weights. want to isolate.
anya: running quick diff now: `docker run -v $PWD:/app redwood/infer:canary v13b --tokenizer=new --seed=43 --prompt-file=longctx_sample.txt` and same with `--tokenizer=old`. will post outputs.
(5m later)
anya: old-tokenizer + fp16: output matches baseline (no halluc), new-tokenizer + fp16: slight token offsets but still factual. new-tokenizer + ptq-int8: reproduces hallucination consistently.
maya: that's... telling. so quantization interaction looks primary. tokenizer shift might change where KV splits happen, exposing quant error.
nick: digging into calibration logs: we used dataset shards that under-represent long-context examples. calibration skew could lead to worse dynamic ranges for attention matmul on long keys.
sam: put another way: the per-channel scales are off for heads that fire on long prefixes. error accumulates as more steps read from wrong scale.
chris: can we quickly rerun calibration including longctx_facts_v2 and re-quantize on canary? if that fixes, it's a calibration-data gap.
maya: yep do that. priority: patch canary to fallback to fp16 for requests with >1500 tokens until we have a fix. put a routing rule in Redwood Console.
deploy-bot: created rollout patch: route v13b-ptq-int8 requests with token_length > 1500 -> v13b-fp16-canary. rollout id: r-2045678922. updated routing in canary group.
anya: attached failing example (id 43): prompt truncated at token boundary X, model invents event on 2001-07-04. full diffs here:
```
--- baseline_fp16.txt
+++ canary_ptq_int8_newtok.txt
@@
...important context about case history...
- On July 4th, 2000 the court ruled...
+ On July 4th, 2001 the committee retroactively declared...
```
chris: also seeing more breakage in structured output tests (dates, citations). those are sensitive to tokenization changes.
maya: mitigation plan: 1) immediate routing rule (done), 2) rerun ptq calibration including long-context corpus and quantize (anya/nick), 3) run extended nightly evals on longctx_facts_v2 with new calibration and both tokenizers (sam), 4) add automated gate: if long_context_factuality delta < -5% fail rollout.
nick: started calibration run with longctx shards included. ETA ~40m.
sam: kicking off extended nightly on canary fixtures now. will post results.
(45m later)
sam: quick status: new-calib + ptq-int8 reduces error by ~9% vs previous ptq but still -5% vs fp16 on that promptset.
maya: progress. keep iterating. could be that int8 still insufficient for heads working with long KV; consider int4/8-mixed or selective fp16 for some layers.
chris: good note: we can also try fudge: per-request detection of long-context and use KV chunking to reduce accumulation length (cheap). add as intermediate mitigation.
anya: experiment log: added chunking + new-calib -> parity with fp16 on 90% of samples. pushing results to artifacts.
maya: ok capture next steps and owner:
- nick: finish calibration tuning, try per-head scale constraints (owner: nick)
- anya: rerun quant with new-calib + chunking, push artifact (owner: anya)
- sam: full extended nightly run + regression alert (owner: sam)
- chris: add tokenization-compat test to preflight to detect any BPE shift effect (owner: chris)
- eng-sre: monitor rollback impact on latency (owner: infra — pinging separately)
maya: think we should also add a small eval harness that samples long-context examples into calibration by default. I'll open a PR for the harness.
chris: thanks all. feel free to DM if you want to pair on the per-head constraints.
anya: uploading final artifact: https://evals.local/artifacts/2045678901/final-run.tar.gz
maya: wrapping up: logged incident card, temporary routing in place, continuing quant+tokenizer work. will update thread when extended nightly completes. :white_check_mark:
